meta.note: Hand-written B1 example sentences for CET entries that lack source examples. Lazy-loaded by review cloze.

acceptance.en: Her acceptance of the job offer surprised everyone at home.
acceptance.zh: 她接受这份工作的决定让家里每个人都很惊讶。

accessary.en: The court treated him as an accessary to the robbery.
accessary.zh: 法院将他视为这起抢劫案的从犯。

accommodation.en: The hotel offers free accommodation for conference guests.
accommodation.zh: 这家酒店为会议来宾提供免费住宿。

accordance.en: All work must be done in accordance with safety rules.
accordance.zh: 所有工作都必须按照安全规定完成。

according.en: According to the weather report, it will rain tonight.
according.zh: 根据天气预报，今晚会下雨。

across.en: There is a small cafe across the street from the school.
across.zh: 学校对面的街上有一家小咖啡馆。

address.en: The mayor promised to address the traffic problem next month.
address.zh: 市长承诺下个月着手解决交通问题。

advocator.en: She is a strong advocator of clean energy in her city.
advocator.zh: 她是本市清洁能源的坚定倡导者。

all.en: All the students passed the final English test.
all.zh: 所有学生都通过了期末英语考试。

amongst.en: He felt calm and safe amongst his old friends.
amongst.zh: 置身老朋友之中，他感到平静而安心。

anyhow.en: The plan was not perfect, but we decided to try it anyhow.
anyhow.zh: 计划并不完美，但我们还是决定试一试。

anyway.en: It was getting late, so we went home anyway.
anyway.zh: 天色已晚，我们还是回家了。

appliance.en: Please turn off every kitchen appliance before you leave.
appliance.zh: 离开前请关掉厨房里的每件电器。

approximately.en: The trip takes approximately two hours by train.
approximately.zh: 坐火车大约需要两个小时。

arrange.en: Please arrange these books by author on the shelf.
arrange.zh: 请把这些书按作者整理到书架上。

astronaut.en: The astronaut shared photos from space with school children.
astronaut.zh: 宇航员与学生们分享了从太空拍的照片。

aunt.en: My aunt visits us every spring with homemade cookies.
aunt.zh: 我姑妈每年春天都会带着自制饼干来看我们。

avail.en: Their efforts did not avail against the strong storm.
avail.zh: 面对强风暴，他们的努力毫无用处。

aviate.en: He learned to aviate small planes when he was twenty.
aviate.zh: 他二十岁时就学会了驾驶小型飞机。

awfully.en: I am awfully sorry for missing your birthday party.
awfully.zh: 错过你的生日聚会，我非常抱歉。

barn.en: The farmer stored hay and tools in the old wooden barn.
barn.zh: 农夫把干草和工具存放在那座旧木谷仓里。

basketball.en: They play basketball in the park every Saturday morning.
basketball.zh: 他们每周六早上都在公园打篮球。

bathroom.en: Please leave the bathroom clean after you shower.
bathroom.zh: 淋浴后请保持浴室整洁。

behalf.en: I am writing this letter on behalf of the whole class.

behavior.en: Good behavior in class helps everyone learn better.
behavior.zh: 课堂上的良好行为有助于大家学得更好。

berry.en: She picked a sweet red berry from the bush.
berry.zh: 她从灌木上摘下一颗甜甜的红浆果。

blanket.en: He pulled the warm blanket up to his chin and fell asleep.
blanket.zh: 他把暖和的毯子拉到下巴，很快就睡着了。

both.en: Both answers are correct, so you may choose either one.
both.zh: 两个答案都对，所以你可以任选其一。

bound.en: If you work hard, you are bound to see progress.
bound.zh: 只要努力，你一定会看到进步。

brute.en: People called the cruel king a brute for his harsh laws.
brute.zh: 人们称那位残酷的国王为畜生，因为他的法律十分苛刻。

bucket.en: She filled a bucket with cold water from the well.
bucket.zh: 她用水井打了一桶冷水。

bud.en: A tiny green bud appeared on the rose bush in spring.
bud.zh: 春天时，玫瑰丛上冒出了一个小小的绿芽。

bulk.en: The shop sells rice in bulk at a lower price.
bulk.zh: 这家店批量出售大米，价格更低。

butcher.en: The local butcher prepared fresh chicken for the market.
butcher.zh: 当地的屠夫为市场准备了新鲜鸡肉。

cabin.en: We spent the weekend in a quiet cabin by the lake.
cabin.zh: 我们在湖边一座安静的小屋里度过了周末。

can.en: Please open a can of tomatoes for the pasta sauce.
can.zh: 请开一罐番茄做意大利面酱。

canoe.en: They paddled a canoe slowly down the quiet river.
canoe.zh: 他们划着独木舟，慢慢沿平静的河水下行。

caregiver.en: The caregiver helped the elderly man take his medicine on time.
caregiver.zh: 照料者帮助那位老人按时服药。

cart.en: A horse pulled a heavy cart full of fresh vegetables.
cart.zh: 一匹马拉着一辆装满新鲜蔬菜的运货车。

catalog.en: I found the camera I wanted in the online product catalog.
catalog.zh: 我在网上的产品目录里找到了想要的相机。

cigaret.en: He put out the cigaret and promised to stop smoking.
cigaret.zh: 他掐灭了香烟，并承诺戒烟。

clay.en: The children shaped soft clay into little animals.
clay.zh: 孩子们把软黏土捏成了小动物。

colonel.en: The colonel inspected the soldiers early in the morning.
colonel.zh: 上校一大早就检阅了士兵。

color.en: What color do you want to paint the bedroom walls?
color.zh: 你想把卧室的墙刷成什么颜色？

comprehension.en: Reading every day improves your reading comprehension.
comprehension.zh: 每天阅读能提高你的阅读理解能力。

conform.en: All products must conform to the new safety standards.
conform.zh: 所有产品都必须符合新的安全标准。

conscience.en: His conscience would not let him keep the lost wallet.
conscience.zh: 良心不允许他把捡到的钱包据为己有。

contract.en: They signed a one-year contract with the new company.
contract.zh: 他们与新公司签订了一年合同。

could.en: She could speak three languages by the age of ten.
could.zh: 她十岁时就会说三种语言。

counseling.en: He received counseling after losing his job last year.
counseling.zh: 去年失业后，他接受了心理咨询。

course.en: This course teaches practical skills for everyday English.
course.zh: 这门课教授日常英语实用技能。

delightful.en: We had a delightful picnic under the cherry trees.
delightful.zh: 我们在樱桃树下度过了一次愉快的野餐。

desk.en: Please leave your homework on the teacher's desk.
desk.zh: 请把作业放在老师的桌上。

determination.en: With strong determination, she finished the long race.
determination.zh: 凭着坚强的意志，她跑完了长跑。

diagram.en: The diagram on the board shows how the engine works.
diagram.zh: 黑板上的图解说明了发动机的工作原理。

difficulty.en: She had difficulty finding a quiet place to study.
difficulty.zh: 她很难找到安静的地方学习。

direction.en: Can you tell me the direction to the nearest subway station?
direction.zh: 你能告诉我去最近地铁站的方向吗？

dishonour.en: Cheating in an exam would bring dishonour to the whole school.
dishonour.zh: 考试作弊会给全校带来耻辱。

displease.en: Loud music late at night will displease the neighbors.
displease.zh: 深夜大声放音乐会惹恼邻居。

dispose.en: Please dispose of the empty bottles in the recycling bin.
dispose.zh: 请把空瓶子扔进回收箱。

domination.en: The team kept its domination of the league for three years.
domination.zh: 这支球队连续三年保持着联赛主导地位。

donkey.en: A gray donkey carried bags of grain up the mountain path.
donkey.zh: 一头灰色的驴沿着山路驮着几袋粮食。

downfall.en: Poor planning led to the sudden downfall of the project.
downfall.zh: 糟糕的规划导致了这个项目的突然垮台。

dragon.en: In the story, a brave girl faces a fire-breathing dragon.
dragon.zh: 故事里，一位勇敢的女孩面对一条喷火巨龙。

dramatically.en: House prices rose dramatically in the last two years.
dramatically.zh: 过去两年房价急剧上涨。

drill.en: The workers used a heavy drill to make holes in the wall.
drill.zh: 工人们用沉重的钻头在墙上打孔。

either.en: You may take either bus; both go to the city center.
either.zh: 两路公交车你坐哪一路都行，都去市中心。

enquire.en: I called the hotel to enquire about available rooms.
enquire.zh: 我打电话向酒店询问是否有空房。

enroll.en: Students must enroll in the course before next Friday.
enroll.zh: 学生必须在下周五前报名选课。

enrollment.en: Online enrollment for the summer school opens in May.
enrollment.zh: 暑期学校的网上报名五月开始。

establishment.en: The new research establishment opened on the university campus.
establishment.zh: 这所新的研究机构在大学校园内开幕。

everybody.en: Everybody in the room stood up and clapped.
everybody.zh: 房间里每个人都站起来鼓掌。

exclusively.en: This parking area is exclusively for hospital staff.
exclusively.zh: 这个停车区专供医院员工使用。

experiment.en: The science experiment showed how plants need light.
experiment.zh: 这个科学实验说明了植物需要光照。

expression.en: Her facial expression showed that she was surprised.
expression.zh: 她的面部表情表明她很惊讶。

extent.en: To some extent, luck played a role in his success.
extent.zh: 在某种程度上，运气在他的成功中起了作用。

fact.en: It is a well-known fact that exercise is good for health.
fact.zh: 运动有益健康是一个众所周知的事实。

farmer.en: The farmer woke up early to milk the cows.
farmer.zh: 农夫很早起床去挤牛奶。

favor.en: Could you do me a favor and carry this box upstairs?
favor.zh: 你能帮我个忙，把这个箱子搬上楼吗？

favorable.en: We are waiting for more favorable weather before the trip.
favorable.zh: 我们在等更有利的天气再出发。

fine.en: You may have to pay a fine if you park here illegally.
fine.zh: 如果在这里违章停车，你可能要交罚款。

flour.en: She mixed flour and eggs to make the cake batter.
flour.zh: 她把面粉和鸡蛋混合做成蛋糕糊。

formulate.en: Scientists formulate new questions after each discovery.
formulate.zh: 科学家在每次发现之后都会提出新问题。

fourfold.en: Sales increased fourfold after the product redesign.
fourfold.zh: 产品重新设计后，销量增长了四倍。

fraction.en: Only a small fraction of the plastic is recycled.
fraction.zh: 只有一小部分塑料被回收。

from.en: The train from Beijing arrives at platform three.
from.zh: 从北京来的火车停靠在三号站台。

fruitful.en: Our meeting was short but very fruitful.
fruitful.zh: 我们的会议虽短，但很有成效。

fulfill.en: She worked hard to fulfill her promise to her parents.
fulfill.zh: 她努力兑现对父母的承诺。

fur.en: The cat's soft fur felt warm under my hand.
fur.zh: 猫柔软的皮毛摸起来暖暖的。

furnace.en: The old furnace kept the house warm all winter.
furnace.zh: 那台旧炉子让房子整个冬天都很暖和。

gay.en: The streets were gay with lights during the festival.
gay.zh: 节日期间街道灯火通明、热闹欢快。

generalization.en: Avoid making a generalization based on only one example.
generalization.zh: 不要仅凭一个例子就下笼统的结论。

golden.en: They spent a golden afternoon walking by the sea.
golden.zh: 他们在海边度过了一个美好的下午。

governor.en: The governor visited schools damaged by the flood.
governor.zh: 州长视察了被洪水损坏的学校。

gown.en: The graduate wore a black gown at the ceremony.
gown.zh: 毕业生在典礼上穿着黑色长袍。

gramme.en: One gramme of salt is enough for this soup.
gramme.zh: 这碗汤加一克盐就够了。

gratitude.en: She wrote a short note to express her gratitude.
gratitude.zh: 她写了一张短笺表达感谢。

greenhouse.en: Tomatoes grow well in the warm greenhouse in winter.
greenhouse.zh: 冬天番茄在温暖的温室里长得很好。

groundlessly.en: He was groundlessly accused of breaking the window.
groundlessly.zh: 他被毫无根据地指责打破了窗户。

guitar.en: He learned to play the guitar from his older brother.
guitar.zh: 他跟哥哥学会了弹吉他。

gunpowder.en: Gunpowder was invented in ancient China.

hardworking.en: She is a hardworking student who never misses class.
hardworking.zh: 她是个从不缺课的勤奋学生。

hawk.en: A hawk circled high above the open field.
hawk.zh: 一只鹰在开阔的田野上空盘旋。

headquarter.en: The company's headquarter is in Shanghai.

hedge.en: A green hedge surrounds the quiet garden.
hedge.zh: 一道绿色树篱环绕着安静的花园。

hence.en: The road was closed; hence we took another way home.
hence.zh: 那条路封闭了，因此我们另择路回家。

hesitate.en: Do not hesitate to ask if you need help.
hesitate.zh: 如果需要帮助，请不要犹豫，尽管开口。

honey.en: She stirred a spoon of honey into the hot tea.
honey.zh: 她往热茶里搅了一勺蜂蜜。

honor.en: It is an honor to speak at your graduation ceremony.
honor.zh: 能在你们的毕业典礼上讲话是一种荣幸。

hospitalize.en: Doctors may hospitalize patients with high fever.
hospitalize.zh: 医生可能会让高烧病人住院。

hot.en: Be careful; the soup is still very hot.

impermanency.en: The impermanency of fashion trends surprises few designers.
impermanency.zh: 时尚潮流的短暂无常并不让设计师感到意外。

implication.en: The report's implication is that we must cut waste.
implication.zh: 报告的含义是我们必须减少浪费。

import.en: The country must import oil from overseas.
import.zh: 这个国家必须从海外进口石油。

importance.en: Teachers often talk about the importance of reading.
importance.zh: 老师们经常谈论阅读的重要性。

installment.en: The first installment of the payment is due next Monday.
installment.zh: 第一期付款下周一到期。

interaction.en: Classroom interaction helps students remember new words.
interaction.zh: 课堂互动帮助学生记住生词。

interpreter.en: An interpreter helped the visitors understand the speech.
interpreter.zh: 口译员帮助来访者听懂演讲。

irrationally.en: He acted irrationally when he threw away the tickets.
irrationally.zh: 他把票扔掉时表现得很不理智。

jazz.en: They listened to soft jazz in the quiet cafe.
jazz.zh: 他们在安静的咖啡馆里听着柔和的爵士乐。

lamb.en: A newborn lamb stood beside its mother in the field.
lamb.zh: 一只刚出生的小羊羔站在田野里的母羊身边。

lame.en: The horse went lame after running on the hard road.
lame.zh: 那匹马在硬路上跑过后腿瘸了。

lap.en: The child fell asleep in his mother's lap.
lap.zh: 孩子在母亲膝上睡着了。

lead.en: Too much lead in drinking water is dangerous.
lead.zh: 饮用水中铅过多很危险。

liquor.en: The shop cannot sell liquor to anyone under eighteen.
liquor.zh: 这家店不得向未满十八岁者出售烈酒。

locomotive.en: An old steam locomotive is kept in the railway museum.
locomotive.zh: 铁路博物馆里保存着一辆旧蒸汽机车。

logically.en: She explained the problem logically step by step.
logically.zh: 她一步一步有条理地讲解了这个问题。

marvelous.en: We had a marvelous view of the mountains from the hotel.
marvelous.zh: 从酒店望去，山景美极了。

meadow.en: Cows were eating grass quietly in the green meadow.
meadow.zh: 牛群在绿色草地上安静地吃草。

microcomputer.en: Every office desk had a microcomputer in the 1990s.
microcomputer.zh: 二十世纪九十年代，每张办公桌上都有一台微型计算机。

mineral.en: This water is rich in mineral content from the spring.
mineral.zh: 这种水富含泉水中的矿物质。

mold.en: Bread left in a damp place will soon grow mold.
mold.zh: 面包放在潮湿的地方很快就会发霉。

motivation.en: Praise can increase a child's motivation to learn.
motivation.zh: 表扬可以提高孩子的学习动力。

mutually.en: The two companies reached a mutually helpful agreement.
mutually.zh: 两家公司达成了互利协议。

narrow.en: The car slowly entered the narrow village street.
narrow.zh: 汽车缓缓驶入狭窄的乡村街道。

neighborhood.en: Their neighborhood has a small park and a bakery.
neighborhood.zh: 他们所在的街区有一座小公园和一家面包店。

ninth.en: She finished in ninth place in the long race.
ninth.zh: 她在长跑中获得第九名。

oak.en: A tall oak stands in the middle of the school yard.
oak.zh: 校园中央矗立着一棵高大的橡树。

oar.en: He pulled hard on the oar to move the boat forward.
oar.zh: 他用力划桨，推动小船前进。

occasionally.en: We occasionally eat out on Friday evenings.
occasionally.zh: 我们偶尔在周五晚上外出就餐。

offense.en: Using phones in class is treated as a serious offense.
offense.zh: 上课使用手机会被视为严重违规。

official.en: An official notice was posted on the school gate.
official.zh: 学校门口张贴了一则官方通知。

okay.en: Is it okay if I open the window a little?
okay.zh: 我稍微开一点窗可以吗？

ought.en: You ought to see a doctor about that cough.
ought.zh: 你应该去看看医生，查一下咳嗽。

outskirt.en: They live on the outskirt of the busy city.
outskirt.zh: 他们住在这座繁忙城市的郊外。

overlook.en: Do not overlook small mistakes in your homework.
overlook.zh: 作业里的小错误也不要忽视。

ox.en: An ox pulled the heavy wooden cart through the field.
ox.zh: 一头牛拉着沉重的木车穿过田野。

passively.en: He sat passively and did not join the discussion.
passively.zh: 他被动地坐着，没有参加讨论。

paw.en: The cat placed a soft paw on my arm.
paw.zh: 猫把一只软软的爪子放在我胳膊上。

pick.en: Please pick a book you would like to read next.
pick.zh: 请挑一本你接下来想读的书。

pork.en: They cooked pork with vegetables for dinner.
pork.zh: 他们晚餐做了猪肉炒蔬菜。

postgraduate.en: She became a postgraduate student after finishing college.
postgraduate.zh: 大学毕业后，她成了一名研究生。

precision.en: The machine cuts metal with great precision.
precision.zh: 这台机器切割金属极为精确。

prefer.en: I prefer tea to coffee in the morning.
prefer.zh: 早上我更喜欢喝茶而不是咖啡。

probably.en: It will probably rain later this afternoon.
probably.zh: 今天下午晚些时候很可能会下雨。

procedure.en: Follow this procedure to reset your password.
procedure.zh: 按照这个步骤重置密码。

prohibitively.en: Tickets for the concert were prohibitively expensive.
prohibitively.zh: 这场音乐会的票贵得让人望而却步。

prosper.en: Small shops prosper when more people move into the area.
prosper.zh: 随着更多人迁入，小商店生意兴隆起来。

provided.en: You may borrow the book provided you return it tomorrow.
provided.zh: 只要你明天归还，就可以借这本书。

providing.en: We can start early, providing the weather stays clear.
providing.zh: 只要天气保持晴好，我们就可以早点出发。

racially.en: The school is racially mixed and welcomes all students.
racially.zh: 这所学校种族构成多元，欢迎所有学生。

radically.en: The new law radically changed how taxes are collected.
radically.zh: 新法律彻底改变了征税方式。

ratio.en: The ratio of teachers to students is one to twenty.

really.en: Do you really believe that story is true?
really.zh: 你真的相信那个故事是真的吗？

reflexion.en: After a long reflexion, she decided to change jobs.
reflexion.zh: 经过长时间的反思，她决定换工作。

refrigerator.en: Please put the milk back in the refrigerator.

relativity.en: Einstein is famous for his theory of relativity.
relativity.zh: 爱因斯坦因相对论而闻名。

repave.en: The city will repave the broken street next month.
repave.zh: 市政府下个月将重新铺设那条破损的街道。

reservior.en: The mountain reservior supplies water to three towns.
reservior.zh: 这座山区水库为三个城镇供水。

reservoir.en: The city reservoir was almost empty after the dry summer.
reservoir.zh: 干旱的夏天过后，城市水库几乎干涸。

ring.en: Please ring the doorbell if nobody answers your knock.
ring.zh: 如果敲门没人应，请按门铃。

scary.en: The dark forest path looked scary at night.
scary.zh: 夜里那条黑暗的林间小路看起来很吓人。

showmanship.en: His showmanship made the science talk exciting for children.
showmanship.zh: 他的表演技巧让这场科学讲座对孩子们来说十分精彩。

silver.en: She wore a thin silver necklace to the party.
silver.zh: 她戴着一条细细的银项链去参加聚会。

specialize.en: Doctors at this clinic specialize in children's health.
specialize.zh: 这家诊所的医生专攻儿童健康。

spread.en: Please spread butter on the warm bread.
spread.zh: 请把黄油涂在热面包上。

subtract.en: If you subtract five from twelve, you get seven.

sulfur.en: The air near the factory smelled of sulfur.
sulfur.zh: 工厂附近的空气有硫磺气味。

suspicion.en: Police held him on suspicion of stealing the bike.
suspicion.zh: 警方因涉嫌偷车扣留了他。

sweater.en: She put on a warm sweater before going outside.
sweater.zh: 她出门前穿上了一件暖和的毛衣。

temple.en: Tourists visited an ancient temple on the hill.
temple.zh: 游客参观了山上的一座古庙。

tighten.en: Please tighten the screws so the chair does not shake.
tighten.zh: 请拧紧螺丝，免得椅子晃动。

trait.en: Honesty is an important trait in a good friend.
trait.zh: 诚实是好朋友的重要特质。

treatment.en: Early treatment can stop the infection from spreading.
treatment.zh: 早期治疗可以阻止感染扩散。

unaffordable.en: City center flats have become unaffordable for many young people.
unaffordable.zh: 市中心的公寓对许多年轻人来说已变得买不起。

vigorous.en: A vigorous walk every morning keeps him healthy.
vigorous.zh: 每天早上有力的散步让他保持健康。

waggon.en: The old waggon carried apples to the village market.
waggon.zh: 那辆旧四轮马车把苹果运到乡村市场。

wax.en: She used wax to make the wooden table shine.
wax.zh: 她用蜡把木桌擦得发亮。

whichever.en: Take whichever seat is free near the window.
whichever.zh: 靠窗哪一个空座位你都可以坐。

whilst.en: He listened to music whilst he cooked dinner.
whilst.zh: 他一边做饭一边听音乐。
